title: Home screen — premium fan or premium ring
question: Porcelain, one champagne hairline, all areas equal, no glow. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Porcelain fan
options.thesis: The fan you already like, rebuilt as seven matte porcelain segments around a pressed-in Day's end.
options.viewport: Greeting with air above; the fan in the lower-middle, Day's end at its hub; quiet tab bar.
options.risk: The render's geometry is off (the last segment droops past the arc); the build would draw it exactly symmetric.

options.label: Premium ring
options.thesis: Seven porcelain buttons on one champagne hairline circle, Day's end in the centre.
options.viewport: Centred ring with labels outside, Day's end the largest thing on the screen.
options.risk: Sits mid-screen, further from the thumb than the fan.

options.label: Minimal arc (came out as a ring)
options.thesis: Asked for a half arc with buttons on it; the model drew a full ring, near-identical to the premium ring.
options.risk: Not the requested structure; regenerate if the half-arc idea is wanted.
